name: SubstationInspectionRounds
tagline: Walk every substation round on a phone – readings checked against limits, defects tracked to verified repair.
description: A complete substation inspection app for network operators and utilities: route-ordered rounds per substation, readings against low / high alarm limits with a warning margin and trend alerts, condition checks, inspection frequencies with due, overdue and compliance, a guided phone round walk that requires comments and raises defects automatically, P1–P4 defects with due dates, engineering assessment, work orders, crew scheduling with permit-to-work rules, repair and verification by a new reading, deferral to planned outages, a 14-day schedule and a compliance report. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Demo mode with a fictional 6-substation, 64-checkpoint network
Readings against low / high limits with warning margin
Trend alert vs the previous reading
Inspection frequency, due, overdue and compliance %
Guided round walk in route order (phone-first)
Comment required and automatic defect on out-of-limit readings
P1–P4 defect priorities with due-date policy
Assessment, work order, scheduling with permit-to-work
Verification by a new reading inside the limits
Round sheet, work order, CSV and summary outputs
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set SubstationInspectionRounds + Power Pages field control SubstationInspectionRoundsPortal, shared src/app)
